issue.description:
AGENTS.md defines NEEDLE compatibility by research/specs/needle-cli-contract-v1.md and forbids claiming compatibility without passing the corresponding conformance suite, but the only NEEDLE-facing checks in the queue are feature-specific canaries (BR-T18 redaction remediation, BR-T27 claim-epoch consumer canary); no bead covers the general contract. Add a conformance lane that drives the built `bead` binary against the spec — claim/ready-frontier semantics, lifecycle transitions, exit codes, `.beads/issues.jsonl` checkpoint interchange, unknown-field survival — and wire it into the release gate so each release re-proves the compatibility claim.
